title.narrative: Women's agribusiness for food security in Sudan

description.narrative: The proposed intervention aims to enhance food security, increase target agricultural communities households incomes and create jobs, particularly for women and youth in the selected states in Sudan. This will be achieved through boosting the agri- processing productivity; skills development of value chain actors, marketing and trade in agricultural products. The intervention will consolidate and upscale gains made by the ongoing UNIDO value chains project in Kassala state to create business opportunities for farmers, traders, SMEs, including women and youth, and provide them with new skills and the agro-processing equipment, which is required to produce competitive products. To rapidly and sustainably transform strategic value chains and bolster urban and rural agro- enterprises development, the project will seek partnerships with TVETs, research institutions, chambers of commerce, and Universities to establish agribusiness transformation hubs, which will serve as #one-stop shops# where farmers, SMEs and support institutions will develop transactional collaborations while accessing value added services and connecting to markets.
